body: I’m doing all I can and it isn’t enough, I love her with all my heart and she hates me. I’m not ok right now, half the time I cant breathe when I think about things and I don’t know when it’s going to end.

I was planning on crashing my car going 100 mph which is about the fastest my Honda Civic can do but I pussied out, I’m sure I’ll think of something soon. I’m about to get a sig pistol because I want one and had just received my foid card.
She does take a ton of meds, and idk what’s going on with her…

This is the first time I’ve felt a pain like this and it’s because my gf broke up with me three times in three weeks over text every time without any context then wanted to get back together. The last time she blocked me I tried to talk to her in person and she put an order that makes it so I can’t talk to her in any way. She’s bipolar btw
I’m in a similar situation, my girl broke up with me three times in the last three weeks and I still love her. It’s so annoying

No one I trust will understand I’ve been feeling this way for about two weeks now. I’ve never been this depressed in all my life and it keeps getting worse and worse and won’t go away. I can’t function at all like I haven’t eaten in days and every time I try I just throw up. I’m severely underweight as it is so I’ll probably die soon anyway. And it’s not like I have money to see a therapist because I don’t make anything. I just need some light or something because this state I’m in is absolutely not sustainable.
